description: Adds purposeful animation to an existing feature: entrances, list add/remove, drag moves, state changes, hover and press feedback, with timing, easing and reduced-motion handling. Use when the UI feels static, dead or janky, items jump or teleport, or the user asks for transitions, motion or micro-interactions. Not for showpiece WebGL or scroll effects (use ui-advanced-effects).
